create_InferenceSettings: create an InferenceSettings dataclass with tf32, activation checkpointing, merge mole, and compile flags for MLIP inference
create_MLIPInferenceCheckpoint: create an MLIPInferenceCheckpoint dataclass to hold model config, state dict, EMA state dict, and tasks config
use_inference_settings_default: use the inference_settings_default function to get default InferenceSettings for general MLIP inference across most systems
use_inference_settings_turbo: use the inference_settings_turbo function to get optimized InferenceSettings with tf32, compile, and merge mole enabled for long simulations
use_guess_inference_settings: use guess_inference_settings to resolve a string name like default, turbo, or traineval into an InferenceSettings object
